propositions: Eight CI pytest lanes lack per-test hang guards, allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind output with no traceback or culprit identification.
Per-test timeout budgets must be calibrated per-lane from historical runtime data rather than using a single blanket timeout across all external and live-service lanes.

The parity test must detect all four pytest invocation forms (bare pytest, pytest -m, python -m pytest, path-prefixed python -m pytest) and reject any lane lacking both --timeout and --timeout-method=thread flags.
Live-service lanes (external LLM, Jira Cloud, Jira DC harness) exercise C-level blocking calls (flock/socket/subprocess) requiring thread-based timeout method instead of the default signal method.
Minimal venv lanes (_optionality degradation-path) must explicitly install pytest-timeout to honor the timeout flags rather than error on unknown options.
